name: Newgrange
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Newgrange was the palace, called the Brú, of Bóand. Bóand was the goddess of the river that runs beneath the mound. She is sometimes called Eithne. Bóand first lived there with Elcmar, who is sometimes called Nechtan. Later she chose the Dagda as her consort.
